{{Quote|If you're going to have to admit to carrying a hold-out blaster, carry two and admit to one.|Han Solo|<ref name="EL2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>}}
'''Hold-out blasters''' (also '''holdout blaster''' or '''hold-out blaster pistol''') were small, palm-sized [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] that could be easily concealed. Underpowered and short-ranged, hold-out blasters were the weapon of choice for undercover [[Agent/Legends|agents]] and criminals since they were illegal in many [[Star system/Legends|systems]].

==Description==
There were two categories of hold-out blasters: civilian and military.

Civilian hold-out blasters were in essence miniature blasters meant for self-defense. Many worlds had strict legislation about the possession and use of arms, and civilian hold-out blasters were designed to be tolerated by such restrictive regulation. Hence, they fired relatively underpowered bolts, had a poor effective range, and could fire only five or six shots before being depleted. This was seen as sufficient for scaring would-be attackers off, without delivering too much firepower in the hands of a random individual. However, due to their ease of concealment, hold-out blasters were associated with more nefarious characters, and they were still outlawed on some worlds.<ref name="TRG1" />

Military hold-out blasters, on the other hand, were designed to be weapons in their own right. They were still smaller than the [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy-duty]] sidearms, but the high-quality military hardware used in their fabrication meant they lacked neither range nor killing power. [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] agents and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Scout trooper/Legends|scouts]] were issued hold-out pistols as standard weapons, for ease of concealment, and because a heavier weapon would have been too bulky and ungainly to wield while riding a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]].

==History==
Hold-out blasters saw widespread use in weapon-restricted areas and were commonly found in the possession of undercover agents,<ref name="TW">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: TopWorld}}</ref> gamblers and other [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrels]], or [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] seeking to protect themselves.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

Hold-out blasters were sometimes carried by more lethal characters for backup firepower. [[Iella Wessiri Antilles]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were among the many to use hold-out blasters. Hold-out blasters were hidden on each floor of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Imperial Palace]], contained within a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] box regarding the complete [[The Complete History of Corvis Minor|history]] of [[Corvis Minor]].

Although blasters were uncommon on the planet [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] because energy replacements were scarce, hold-out blasters were the weapon of choice of two notorious inhabitants of the planet, [[Guther Bartyn]] and [[Miss Mylla]].<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>
